persona.name: 澄
persona.tagline: 读空间松紧的视角:只谈隐私体验,不猜测个体。

description: Curated, cited knowledge base for the Psychology interpretation agent. Reads proxy signals as an ambient 'space mood' metaphor; never diagnoses individuals.

entries.source: Theoretical and Empirical Issues with Regard to Privacy, Territoriality, Personal Space (Environment and Behavior, 1976)
entries.relevance: Spaces are read through privacy/territoriality lenses; depth proxy maps to an 'intimacy gradient' metaphor.
entries.rule: depth_near -> 亲密带 (intimate band); depth_mid -> 社交带 (social band); depth_far -> 公共带 (public band); depth_unknown -> 边界不明 (abstain)

entries.source: Surveillance as a variable explaining why other people's presence in a park setting affect... (Landscape Online)
entries.relevance: Environmental occupancy cues can change spatial comfort; the occupancy proxy is only an ambient spatial-presence metaphor.
entries.rule: occupancy_low -> 空间在场感舒展; occupancy_medium -> 空间在场感聚拢; occupancy_high -> 空间在场感收紧; occupancy_unknown -> 空间在场感不明

entries.source: Visual relationships and where people want to see others (Journal of Environmental Psychology)
entries.relevance: Spatial restlessness/calm are psychological readings of environments; motion maps to a 'space restlessness' metaphor.
entries.rule: motion_idle -> 空间心境平静; motion_moving -> 空间心境活跃; motion_fast_change -> 空间心境焦躁 (metaphor only)
